ar: بِسْمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ إِنَّآ أَعْطَيْنَٰكَ ٱلْكَوْثَرَ
en: (1) Indeed, We have granted you, [O Muḥammad], al-Kawthar.
(2) So pray to your Lord and offer sacrifice [to Him alone].
(3) Indeed, your enemy is the one cut off.[2002]
enNotes: [2002]- From all good in this world and the Hereafter.
